changeSet.author: bquinlivan
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetResultEdge') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetResultEdge] ( Class int not null ) AS EDGE END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'EC_AssetResultEdge') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetResultEdge] ADD CONSTRAINT [EC_AssetResultEdge] CONNECTION (graph.[AssetNode] To [AssetResult]) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (select * from sys.edge_constraints where name = 'EC_AssetResultEdge') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetResultEdge] DROP CONSTRAINT [EC_AssetResultEdge] END ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetResultEdge] ADD CONSTRAINT [EC_AssetResultEdge] CONNECTION (graph.[AssetNode] To [AssetResult]) ON DELETE CASCADE
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (select * from sys.edge_constraints where name = 'EC_AssetResultEdge') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetResultEdge] DROP CONSTRAINT [EC_AssetResultEdge] END ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetResultEdge] ADD CONSTRAINT [EC_AssetResultEdge] CONNECTION (graph.[AssetNode] To [AssetResult])

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF not EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetResultEdge_From') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetResultEdge_From] ON [dbo].[AssetResultEdge] ($from_id, $to_id) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetResultEdge_From') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_AssetResultEdge_From] ON [dbo].[AssetResultEdge] END
